scripts.format: prettier --write apps/cli/src apps/cli/test apps/cli/scripts/*.ts apps/cli/README.md apps/server packages/shared apps/web test scripts *.json README.md tracks plantilla
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/cli/src apps/cli/test apps/cli/scripts/*.ts apps/cli/README.md apps/server packages/shared apps/web test scripts *.json README.md tracks plantilla
